ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The DNA sequence encoding protein A (sequence A) consists of five fragments, A, B, C, D, and E. The sequences encoding proteins B and C consist of some fragments of sequence A, as shown in Figure 1. Now proteins A, B, and C have been obtained through genetic engineering methods. To identify whether these three proteins have the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation, a student performed the following experiment: a certain amount of culture medium containing T lymphocytes was evenly divided into four groups; equal amounts of protein A, protein B, and protein C were added to three of the groups respectively, and the other group served as a control. They were cultured, and the T lymphocyte concentration was measured regularly. The results are shown in Figure 2. Answer the question: Among the above three proteins A, B, and C, if the peptide segment encoded by which fragment (fill in “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, or “E”) is lacking, will the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation be reduced?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The DNA sequence encoding protein A (sequence A) consists of five fragments, A, B, C, D, and E. The sequences encoding proteins B and C consist of some fragments of sequence A, as shown in Figure 1. Now proteins A, B, and C have been obtained through genetic engineering methods. To identify whether these three proteins have the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation, a student performed the following experiment: a certain amount of culture medium containing T lymphocytes was evenly divided into four groups; equal amounts of protein A, protein B, and protein C were added to three of the groups respectively, and the other group served as a control. They were cultured, and the T lymphocyte concentration was measured regularly. The results are shown in Figure 2. Answer the question: Among the above three proteins A, B, and C, if the peptide segment encoded by which fragment (fill in “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, or “E”) is lacking, will the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation be reduced?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure 1, the sequence corresponding to protein A contains five fragments, A, B, C, D, and E; the sequence corresponding to protein B contains three fragments, B, C, and D; the sequence corresponding to protein C contains two fragments, B and D. In Figure 2, the T lymphocyte concentration curves after adding protein A and protein B both rise markedly and finally approach a relatively high level; the curve after adding protein C is lower, close to the control group, indicating that the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation is markedly weakened. Then reason: Compared with protein A, protein B lacks A and E, but the stimulation effects of the two are similar, indicating that lacking A and E does not markedly reduce the effect. Compared with protein B, protein C shares B and D with it, and the main difference is that B contains C while C lacks C; at the same time, the stimulation effect of protein C is markedly reduced. Therefore, lacking the peptide segment encoded by fragment C will reduce the effect of stimulating T lymphocyte proliferation.
